transcription.text: What do we like about school?
I have four lessons this morning.
I have four lessons this morning too.
Every Monday we raise the national flag.
I work out problems in Maths class.
I like drawing pictures in Art class.
We go to different clubs after school.
Sometimes we put on an English play.
My best friend Yi Yi makes model planes in the science club.
We have a lot of fun.
Is there an English play this week?
Does your teacher act in the play?
Does Jay like reading English stories?
In English class new words we say.
At school we learn things every day.
He's in a school for police dogs.
In the morning he has swimming, running and jumping lessons.
In the afternoon he has smelling and catching lessons.
The smelling lessons are Bailey's favourite.
In the Maths Club we play many different number games.
In the Sports Club we can run and play basketball.
Do you like telling stories in Chinese or English?
Come and join the Drama Club.
